Saqrmisc: Comprehensive Data Analysis and Visualization for R

Source: R/Saqrmisc-package.R
Saqrmisc-package.Rd

A comprehensive R package providing functions for statistical analysis, data transformation, and visualization. Designed for exploratory data analysis with robust error handling and publication-ready outputs.

Main Features

The package is organized into the following function categories:

Group Comparisons

  • compare_groups: Compare groups with t-tests, ANOVA, post-hoc tests, Bayesian analysis, and equivalence testing (TOST). Supports stratified analyses.

Correlation Analysis

  • correlations: Full pairwise correlation table with complete statistics (r, CI, t, df, p, n). Supports bivariate, partial, and semi-partial correlations, group-wise correlations, and multilevel (within-cluster) correlations.

  • correlation_matrix: Publication-ready correlation matrix with significance stars, heatmap visualization, and optional confidence intervals.

Descriptive Statistics

  • descriptive_table: Publication-ready descriptive statistics with gt formatting. Supports 20+ statistics and group stratification.

  • categorical_table: Frequency tables with cross-tabulation, chi-square tests, and Cramer's V effect size.

  • auto_describe: Automatic detection and description of all variables.

  • data_overview: Quick overview of data structure and quality.

Data Transformation

  • center / center_vec: Mean-centering with optional group-wise centering for multilevel data.

  • scale_vars / scale_vec: Scaling by SD or min-max normalization with optional group-wise scaling.

  • standardize / standardize_vec: Z-score standardization with optional group-wise standardization.

  • reverse_code / reverse_code_vec: Reverse coding for Likert scales and similar measures.

Missing Data

  • missing_analysis: Comprehensive missing data analysis with patterns, Little's MCAR test, and visualizations.

  • replace_missing: Imputation using mean, median, mode, or custom values. Supports group-wise imputation.

Outlier Analysis

  • outlier_check: Detect outliers using IQR, Z-score, or Mahalanobis distance methods.

  • replace_outliers: Replace or winsorize outliers.

  • is_outlier / winsorize_vec: Vectorized functions for use with dplyr.

Normality Testing

  • normality_check: Comprehensive normality testing with Shapiro-Wilk, Kolmogorov-Smirnov, and visual diagnostics.

Clustering

  • clustering: Latent profile clustering via the latents package. Supports all 14 covariance structures.

  • get_cluster_assignments: Extract cluster assignments with optional membership probabilities.

  • cluster_diagnostics: Classification diagnostics.

  • model_comparison_table: Compare models by BIC, AIC, or ICL.

  • generate_cluster_report: Generate comprehensive cluster reports.

Categorical Analysis

  • mosaic_analysis: Mosaic plot analysis with chi-square tests, Fisher's exact test, and Cramer's V effect size.

Network Analysis

  • estimate_single_network: Estimate psychological networks using bootnet, mgm, and qgraph.

  • estimate_grouped_networks: Estimate networks by group.

  • compare_networks: Compare networks between groups.

API Design

All functions use a consistent API with quoted strings for variable names:

  • Variable names are passed as character strings (e.g., group_by = "gender")

  • Multiple variables use character vectors (e.g., Vars = c("age", "score"))

  • When Vars = NULL, functions auto-select all numeric variables

Output Formats

Most functions support multiple output formats:

  • format = "gt": Publication-ready gt tables (default)

  • format = "data.frame": Raw data frames for further processing
